incident.what: Between my scratch compile check and my copy into the shared tree, the real folio tree was modified by another lane (timeline.rs doc line pointing fps fractions at accord FrameRate::fps_fraction). My file copy of timeline.rs/lib.rs from the scratch copy overwrote that uncommitted doc edit, and the other lane's pathspec commit 26b37c8 (04:27:47 local) then committed my lib.rs and timeline.rs while layout.rs/story.rs were still untracked, so the pushed HEAD declared modules it did not contain.
incident.repair: cargo check was clean on the working tree; git add of the two new files plus a pathspec commit ae75f55 was pushed about a minute later. The lost doc edit was re-applied from the 26b37c8 commit title (SequenceFrameRate::accord doc now says the fps fraction is Accord's FrameRate::fps_fraction and other conversions are Pulse's); the other lane should confirm the wording.
incident.cause_to_avoid: copying whole files from a scratch copy over a shared tree without re-checking git status immediately before the copy, and leaving new source files untracked while tracked files already reference them. Afterwards: new files are added to the index in the same pathspec commit as the lib.rs that references them, and edits to shared files are in-place replacements, not file copies.
incident.gameplan: not changed: the shared STUDIO-MODULE-BUILD gameplan gates every lane and a step for this cause was not added without a lead decision

design_decisions: Text frame is a field on StudioLayer (spec STU-LAY-017: frames are StudioLayer nodes of text kind), so frame identity is the SLYR layer_id; no new id prefix is needed (Accord has none for frames or pages and is out of scope).

No field was added to StudioDocument: interop-media (test) and pulse (example, test) build StudioDocument struct literals, so a new document member would break them. Pages live inside StudioPageSpread and frames inside StudioLayer; neither has struct-literal constructors outside folio (grep plus dependents check). StudioPageSpread and StudioLayer did gain pub fields (pages, text_frame): any out-of-tree struct literal needs pages: Vec::new() / text_frame: None.

Authored thread state is previous/next only; parent_story, start/end and text_frame_index are derived (text_threads()); overflows/overset is layout output and is not stored in the authored document (no stale derived state in the document).

All layout lengths are Folio Length with unit pt required (STU-LAY-100/105/113/118 declare pt canonical), independent of the document geometry_unit used by spread bounds; spread bounds are not cross-checked against page sizes (different unit domain, no spec rule).

page_id is a document-local key (no page identity prefix in v02.215 or STU-CON-004); applied_language is an opaque language-resource key (no language prefix declared); both use the [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128} grammar.

Optional spec values with no declared default are explicit null (bleed, previous/next links, style_ref, applied_language, paragraph_direction), following link_group in timeline.rs. Enumerations follow STU-LAY-119/120/121 without the autosize./first_baseline./vjust. prefixes; STU-LAY-119 'height_and_width_proportionally' was used over STU-TYP-116 'height_and_width_proportional' (the spec disagrees with itself; the layout-owned clause was chosen).
A story is exactly one chain and a chain exactly one story (STU-LAY-018); two disjoint chains of one story are refused.
The per-spread page limit is not hard-coded (STU-LAY-106): pages count against Budget.nodes; only the STU-LAY-105 pages_per_document hard maximum 9999 is a constant.
gaps_not_stored: Page: document_offset, applied_section, applied_alternate_layout, applied_parent, parent_transform, override_list, parent_page_items, page_colour_label, layout_rule, snapshot_blending_mode, grid_starting_point, use_parent_grid, slug, orientation (STU-LAY-107/105); page-level column guides column_count, column_gutter, column_direction, custom_columns, column_positions (STU-LAY-113); spread page_count, binding_location, allow_page_shuffle, preserve_layout_when_shuffling (STU-LAY-106); document facing_pages, bleed_uniform, slug_uniform, page_binding (STU-LAY-105).

layout_migration: Layout Spread{id,pages} maps to StudioPageSpread{page_spread_id,pages}; Page{id,width_pt,height_pt,margins{top_pt,right_pt,bottom_pt,left_pt}} maps to StudioPage{page_id,width.value,height.value,margins{top,right,bottom,left}} with every Length unit pt. Pages stay left to right; spread coordinates and the zero-gutter placement remain layout's rule (Folio stores none).

Layout TextFrame{id,spread:usize,page:usize,x_pt,y_pt,width_pt,height_pt,inset_pt,first_baseline_pt,obstacles} maps to a text layer with a StudioTextFrame: id = layer_id; (spread,page) = doc.locate_page(frame.page_id) (spread_index, page_index); x/y/width/height = bounds in page coordinates with a top-left origin (same convention); the scalar inset_pt maps to the four-value inset_spacing (layout must accept four sides or require four equal); first_baseline_pt maps only to first_baseline_offset = fixed with minimum_first_baseline_offset (ascent/cap_height/leading/em_box_height/x_height need font metrics: refuse as unsupported or take them from Type); obstacles are not stored and stay a reflow input.

Layout ReflowRequest.thread (indices into frames) maps to doc.text_threads()[i].frames() resolved to layers. Folio refuses cycles (Code::ThreadCycle) and non-reciprocal or mixed-story chains (Code::InvalidThread) at validation; layout's LayoutError::CyclicThread stays as the guard for hand-built input. text_column_count and text_column_gutter are now available but layout is single column today.

Layout story input: StudioTextStory.inline_text() supplies the text for Inline content (Stored content needs the caller's artifact resolver); character_ranges[].applied_language and style_ref feed Type shaping and style resolution; story_direction/paragraph_direction can replace layout's RTL refusal heuristics (right_to_left, or unknown without paragraph directions, stays UnsupportedComposition); LayoutProposal.overset stays layout output and is not written into the document (overflows is derived).
Do not change layout's public types until the lead decides; the crate-local TextFrame/Spread remain valid for the validator round on layout commit 259ea44.
